message.content: A medium‑sized apple (about 182 g) typically contains around **95 calories**. Smaller apples have fewer calories (≈ 77 kcal for a 149 g apple), while larger ones have more (≈ 116 kcal for a 223 g apple). The exact number can vary slightly depending on the variety and ripeness.
